For a 50-person Indian company, the main switching cost is implementation/admin effort, not a published subscription fee. Most providers quote pricing after assessing travel volume.

Provider	Cost model	Switching difficulty
MakeMyTrip myBiz	No public platform fee; corporate fares + booking economics	Low — account, policies and employee upload can be set up quickly. 
MakeMyTrip Biz
+1

Thomas Cook India	Custom quote; managed servicing/booking fees negotiated	Medium-high — policy, approval workflows, GST/expense setup and dedicated servicing need migration. 
Thomas Cook

FCM Travel	Custom enterprise/TMC commercial terms	High — deeper programme configuration, integrations and implementation; suited to structured corporate travel. 
FCM Travel
+1

Practical switching cost: budget 1–4 weeks for a basic platform migration and potentially 4–8+ weeks for a fully managed TMC rollout, depending on integrations and approval complexity.

Before switching, request: per-booking/service fees, GST treatment, cancellation/change handling fees, implementation fee, minimum commitment, and data/export terms.

For a 50-person Indian company, these three are practical benchmarks. Public corporate pricing is mostly quote-based, so I would not treat any invented per-booking figure as reliable.

Provider	Cost structure	Switching difficulty
MakeMyTrip myBiz
	₹0 annual subscription; transaction/service fees can apply by contract. 
MakeMyTrip
+1
	Low — self-serve setup, employee invites and policy configuration. 
MakeMyTrip Business

Yatra for Business
	Travel Lite targets SMEs under ₹1 crore/year; Travel Pro covers businesses under ₹5 crore/year. Pricing is enquiry-based. 
Yatra.com
	Low–medium — policies, approvals, reports and multiple booking channels require migration of employee/travel data.
FCM Travel India
	Quote-based managed TMC; negotiated corporate rates and dedicated service rather than published subscription pricing. 
FCM Travel
+1
	Medium–high — implementation, policy configuration, integrations and traveller profiles make migration more involved. 
FCM Travel

Practical takeaway: myBiz is easiest to switch into/out of; Yatra offers a similar SME-oriented model; FCM is a deeper managed-service migration. For a 50-person company, request each vendor's per-booking/service fee, implementation fee, minimum annual spend, cancellation/change charges and exit terms before comparing total cost.
